nodes.Name: Header
nodes.DocComment:
A Header represents the key-value pairs in an HTTP header.

The keys should be in canonical form, as returned by
[CanonicalHeaderKey].

nodes.Name: Add
nodes.DocComment:
Add adds the key, value pair to the header.
It appends to any existing values associated with key.
The key is case insensitive; it is canonicalized by
[CanonicalHeaderKey].

nodes.Name: Set
nodes.DocComment:
Set sets the header entries associated with key to the
single element value. It replaces any existing values
associated with key. The key is case insensitive; it is
canonicalized by [textproto.CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey].
To use non-canonical keys, assign to the map directly.

nodes.Name: Get
nodes.DocComment:
Get gets the first value associated with the given key. If
there are no values associated with the key, Get returns "".
It is case insensitive; [textproto.CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey] is
used to canonicalize the provided key. Get assumes that all
keys are stored in canonical form. To use non-canonical keys,
access the map directly.

nodes.Name: Values
nodes.DocComment:
Values returns all values associated with the given key.
It is case insensitive; [textproto.CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey] is
used to canonicalize the provided key. To use non-canonical
keys, access the map directly.
The returned slice is not a copy.

nodes.Name: get
nodes.DocComment: get is like Get, but key must already be in CanonicalHeaderKey form.

nodes.Name: has
nodes.DocComment:
has reports whether h has the provided key defined, even if it's
set to 0-length slice.

nodes.Name: Del
nodes.DocComment:
Del deletes the values associated with key.
The key is case insensitive; it is canonicalized by
[CanonicalHeaderKey].

nodes.Name: Write
nodes.DocComment: Write writes a header in wire format.

nodes.Name: Clone
nodes.DocComment: Clone returns a copy of h or nil if h is nil.

nodes.Name: ParseTime
nodes.DocComment:
ParseTime parses a time header (such as the Date: header),
trying each of the three formats allowed by HTTP/1.1:
[TimeFormat], [time.RFC850], and [time.ANSIC].

nodes.Name: stringWriter
nodes.DocComment: stringWriter implements WriteString on a Writer.

nodes.Name: headerSorter
nodes.DocComment: headerSorter contains a slice of keyValues sorted by keyValues.key.

nodes.Name: sortedKeyValues
nodes.DocComment:
sortedKeyValues returns h's keys sorted in the returned kvs
slice. The headerSorter used to sort is also returned, for possible
return to headerSorterCache.

nodes.Name: WriteSubset
nodes.DocComment:
WriteSubset writes a header in wire format.
If exclude is not nil, keys where exclude[key] == true are not written.
Keys are not canonicalized before checking the exclude map.

nodes.Name: CanonicalHeaderKey
nodes.DocComment:
CanonicalHeaderKey returns the canonical format of the
header key s. The canonicalization converts the first
letter and any letter following a hyphen to upper case;
the rest are converted to lowercase. For example, the
canonical key for "accept-encoding" is "Accept-Encoding".
If s contains a space or invalid header field bytes, it is
returned without modifications.

nodes.Name: hasToken
nodes.DocComment:
hasToken reports whether token appears with v, ASCII
case-insensitive, with space or comma boundaries.
token must be all lowercase.
v may contain mixed cased.
